deck.title: STA D20 — Dice tools for the final frontier

props.kicker: A tabletop companion for Star Trek Adventures
props.title: STA D20 — dice tools for the ==final frontier==.
props.subtitle: Set the target, roll 2d20, and let the math stay in the computer core.

slides.notes: STA D20 is a companion tool I built for Star Trek Adventures sessions. Open with the hook: the dice math should never slow the story.

items.title: Build the target
items.body: Your officer's Attribute plus Discipline sets the number each die must meet or beat.

items.title: Roll 2d20
items.body: Every die at or under the target scores a success.

items.title: Watch the twenties
items.body: A natural 20 always brings a {c:#ffb85c}complication{/c}, however well the roll went.

items.title: Bank the extra
items.body: Successes beyond the first become {c:#ffb85c}Momentum{/c} — a resource the whole crew can spend.

slides.notes: Walk the table through one roll: target from Attribute + Discipline, two dice, successes under the target, twenties complicate, extras become Momentum.

props.title: Math at the table ==stops the story==.
props.body: Targets, focus ranges, complication ranges — every roll is a small arithmetic problem, and the scene goes quiet mid-adventure while someone works it out.

slides.notes: The pain: the GM narrates a tense moment, then everyone waits while dice math happens. Momentum tracking makes it worse.

left.label: By hand
left.title: Pen, paper, pause
points: Add Attribute + Discipline for every roll

Count successes, re-check twenties, re-count Momentum

right.label: With STA D20

points: Complications and Momentum flagged for you

slides.notes: Same roll, two experiences. STA D20 moves the arithmetic off the table so the scene keeps moving.
